entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is husband of O.P. No. 02.

It is next submitted that petitioner on 19.11.2018 had filed matrimonial case No. 1265 of 2018 in the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Patna seeking divorce from the O.P. No. 02, in which the O.P. No. 02 appeared and filed her written statement on 25.10.2019

, it is next submitted that after appearing in the divorce case and filing written statement, the O.P. No. 02 on 15.11.2019 instituted the present case, which amply demonstrate that the present criminal case has been instituted in retaliation to the matrimonial case No. 1265 of 2018.
(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
